jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d) - Institut für Deutsche und Niederländische Philologie
jobs.reason: The essential requirement lists "Promotion" (a completed doctorate) as an entry condition, which the candidate does not hold. The field — modern German literature/philology — is also entirely outside the candidate's research areas.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Postdoc) - Gender Studies, MATH+ Research Project
jobs.reason: This is a postdoc position (explicitly "wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiter*innen (Postdocs)") in the team, with a completed or near-completed doctorate listed as desired and the framing clearly aimed at PhD-level researchers — the candidate holds only an MSc, so it is a hard mismatch on level. Although a Master's is the formal minimum, the role is a postdoc on gender/organisational sociology (higher-education research), which is adjacent at best and outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d) – Digital Humanities (PhD position)
jobs.reason: This is a salaried, funded doctoral position (E13 TV-L), so it is a genuine paid entry-level role and eligible — the candidate's MSc satisfies the entry requirement and the humanities degree qualifies. However, the paper fit is weak: the desired profile centres on software development, data modelling, XML technologies (XSLT/XQuery/XPath) and teaching Python/R programming courses, which go well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. Digital literary studies also sits outside the candidate's core international-law/security interest zones, so interest pull is low.
jobs.type: Full-time (fixed-term up to 4 years, PhD position)

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d) – Planetologie und Fernerkundung, AG Postberg (SUDA-LILBID)
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is a Master's in a directly related natural-science field (planetology, physics, astronomy, chemistry, biology or geology), which the candidate does not hold, and the work centres on mass spectrometry and laser/vacuum lab techniques far outside their profile. Even the desirable ML component is beyond analysis-level Python, and the topic sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Praedoc) - Strafrecht (Prof. Momsen)
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is a completed First State Examination in law (Erste juristische Prüfung), a German legal qualification the candidate does not hold — this is a hard disqualifier. Although it is a funded praedoc/PhD post, it is reserved for law graduates and centres on criminal / economic criminal law rather than the candidate's field.
